// Generated by crewhaus. DO NOT EDIT.
// Channel-generic gateway: dispatches signed webhooks to the matching adapter.
import { InMemoryDedupStore, type DedupStore } from "@crewhaus/durable-state";
import { readRequestBodyCapped, resolveWebhookBodyLimit } from "@crewhaus/gateway-protocol/body-limit";
import type { ChannelAdapter } from "@crewhaus/channel-adapter-slack";
import { handleInboundEvent } from "@crewhaus/channel-adapter-base";
import { createApprovalActions } from "@crewhaus/channel-adapter-base";
import type { ApprovalStore, ApprovalAuditSink } from "@crewhaus/channel-adapter-base";
import type { SessionRouter } from "./session-router.js";

export type GatewayConfig = {
  adapters: ReadonlyMap<string, ChannelAdapter>;
  sessionRouter: SessionRouter;
  /**
   * G11 — the shared pending-approval store. A click on the
   * `/<adapter>/actions` route is decided on its session root; the parked turn
   * (in the session-router) awaits the same store. Absent ⇒ the actions route
   * ACKs and ignores (no approval surface).
   */
  approvals?: ApprovalStore;
  /** G48 — durable audit sink; an approval resolution appends one record. */
  auditSink?: ApprovalAuditSink;
  /** Maximum number of inbound idempotency keys remembered before LRU eviction (in-memory store only). */
  dedupCapacity?: number;
  /**
   * SECURITY (audit R3) — replay-dedup store keyed by adapter-supplied
   * idempotency keys (Slack event_id, Discord interaction id, WhatsApp
   * message id, ...). Default: in-memory bounded LRU — volatile, so a
   * daemon restart forgets seen keys and a captured webhook can be replayed
   * inside its signature window. Multi-process or restart-safe deployments
   * pass a durable store (the daemon wires CREWHAUS_DEDUP_STORE=sqlite:<path>
   * through createDedupStore).
   */
  dedupStore?: DedupStore;
  /**
   * Most bytes of a request body the adapter routes read; a larger body is
   * answered 413 before its signature is checked. Default: what
   * CHANNEL_WEBHOOK_MAX_BYTES says (1 MiB when unset). The daemon resolves it
   * once and passes the same number to Bun.serve's maxRequestBodySize.
   */
  maxBodyBytes?: number;
};

export type Gateway = {
  handle(req: Request): Promise<Response>;
};

export function createGateway(config: GatewayConfig): Gateway {
  const dedup: DedupStore =
    config.dedupStore ?? new InMemoryDedupStore({ capacity: config.dedupCapacity ?? 10_000 });
  const maxBodyBytes = config.maxBodyBytes ?? resolveWebhookBodyLimit(process.env).maxBytes;
  // A click on an approval card is decided as the member the clicker is linked to.
  const approvalActions =
    config.approvals !== undefined
      ? createApprovalActions({
          approvals: config.approvals,
          adapters: config.adapters,
          sessionRouter: config.sessionRouter,
          ...(config.auditSink !== undefined ? { auditSink: config.auditSink } : {}),
        })
      : undefined;

  return {
    async handle(req: Request): Promise<Response> {
      const url = new URL(req.url);
      // G11 — interactivity webhook (an Approve/Deny button click), verified
      // with the SAME signing machinery as an events webhook, then decided by
      // channel-adapter-base. Path: /<adapter>/actions.
      const actionMatch = url.pathname.match(/^\/([^/]+)\/actions$/);
      if (actionMatch && actionMatch[1] !== undefined) {
        const actionAdapter = config.adapters.get(actionMatch[1]);
        if (!actionAdapter || !actionAdapter.parseInteraction) {
          return new Response("unknown channel", { status: 404 });
        }
        // Held to the body limit before the signature is checked, the same
        // read as the events route below.
        const actionRead = await readRequestBodyCapped(req, maxBodyBytes);
        if (!actionRead.ok) return actionRead.response;
        const actionReq = { headers: req.headers, body: actionRead.text };
        if (!actionAdapter.verify(actionReq)) {
          return new Response("invalid signature", { status: 401 });
        }
        const interaction = actionAdapter.parseInteraction(actionReq);
        if (interaction.kind !== "approval_action" || approvalActions === undefined) {
          return new Response("ok", { status: 200 });
        }
        return approvalActions.handle(interaction, actionAdapter);
      }
      // Match adapter by path prefix: /slack/events → "slack".
      const match = url.pathname.match(/^\/([^/]+)\/events$/);
      if (!match || match[1] === undefined) return new Response("not found", { status: 404 });
      const adapter = config.adapters.get(match[1]);
      if (!adapter) return new Response("unknown channel", { status: 404 });

      // Subscription handshake (Meta/WhatsApp `hub.challenge`): an unsigned
      // GET with no body, so it cannot go through verify()/parseInbound() —
      // the adapter authenticates it against its own shared verify token and
      // we echo the challenge only on its say-so. Adapters whose platform has
      // no such handshake leave `handshake` undefined and fall through to the
      // signed path below unchanged.
      if (req.method === "GET" && adapter.handshake !== undefined) {
        const handshake = adapter.handshake({ headers: req.headers, url });
        if (handshake.kind === "challenge") {
          return new Response(handshake.challenge, {
            status: 200,
            headers: { "content-type": "text/plain" },
          });
        }
        return new Response("verification failed", { status: 403 });
      }

      // The platform signs the raw body, so it is read before verify() — but
      // never more of it than the limit: a declared Content-Length over it is
      // answered 413 unread, and a streamed body is counted as it arrives and
      // answered 413 the moment it passes the limit.
      const read = await readRequestBodyCapped(req, maxBodyBytes);
      if (!read.ok) return read.response;
      const rawReq = { headers: req.headers, body: read.text };
      if (!adapter.verify(rawReq)) {
        return new Response("invalid signature", { status: 401 });
      }
      const parsed = adapter.parseInbound(rawReq);
      if (parsed.kind === "challenge") {
        return new Response(parsed.challenge, {
          status: 200,
          headers: { "content-type": "text/plain" },
        });
      }
      if (parsed.kind === "skip") {
        return new Response("ok", { status: 200 });
      }
      if (parsed.kind === "reaction") {
        return new Response("ok", { status: 200 });
      }
      // event — deduped, put on record, then acknowledged; the model turn runs
      // off the request path (channel-adapter-base's handleInboundEvent).
      return handleInboundEvent(parsed.event, adapter, { dedup, sessionRouter: config.sessionRouter });
    },
  };
}
